original: pratyakṣato na bhagavān sugato na viṣṇur
analyzed: pratyakṣatas na bhagavān sugataḥ na viṣṇuḥ

original: ālokyate na ca haro na hiraṇyagarbhaḥ|
analyzed: ālokyate na ca haraḥ na hiraṇyagarbhaḥ
teṣāṁ tu rūpa carita atiśaya prabhāvān

original: śrutvā vicārayata ko guṇavān na veti||1||
analyzed: śrutvā vicārayata kaḥ guṇavān na vā iti
śaṃbhuḥ lalat nara śira ugra kapāla mālī
ekānta śānta carita atiśayaḥ tu buddhaḥ
kaṁ pūjayāmi uta śāntam a śānta rūpam
duryodhana ādi kula nāśa karaḥ babhūva
viṣṇuḥ haraḥ tripura dāha karaḥ kila āsīt
krauñcaṁ guhaḥ pi dṛḍha śakti hataṁ cakāra

original: buddhas tu kevalam asau jagato hitaiṣī||3||
analyzed: buddhaḥ tu kevalam asau jagataḥ hita eṣī

original: pīḍyo mayāyam ayam eva tu rakṣaṇīyo
analyzed: pīḍyaḥ mayā ayam ayam eva tu
vadhyaḥ yam iti api sura uttama nītiḥ eṣā

original: buddhasya naiva ripavo na ca vañcanīyāḥ||4||
analyzed: buddhasya nā eva ripavaḥ na ca vañcanīyāḥ
rāga ādi doṣa janakāni vacāṁ asi viṣṇoḥ
unmatta ceṣṭita karāṇi tathā eva śaṃbhoḥ
vandya tvam arhati ca kaḥ tra vicārayadhvam
yaḥ ca udyataḥ para vadhāya ghṛṇāṁ prahāya

original: trā ṇāya yaś ca jagataḥ kṛpayā pravṛttaḥ|
analyzed: trā nāya yaḥ ca jagataḥ kṛpayā pravṛttaḥ

original: rāgi ca yo bhavati yaś ca vimuktarāgaḥ
analyzed: rāgi ca yaḥ bhavati yaḥ ca vimukta rāgaḥ
vandyaḥ nayoḥ kaḥ iha nāma vada anucintya
śakraṁ vajra dharaṁ balaṁ hala dharaṁ
etān duḥkha bhaya arditān gata ghṛṇān
na ca yuvatim aṅke su vadanāṁ

original: na ca kuliśam ugraṁ na ca halam|
analyzed: na ca kuliśam ugraṁ na ca halam
krūra āśāḥ mahiṣa anta kṛt nara vasā
su alpaḥ pi doṣaḥ sti kaḥ

original: bandhur na naḥ sa bhagavān arayo na cānye
analyzed: bandhuḥ na naḥ sa bhagavān arayaḥ na ca anye
sākṣāt na dṛṣta caraḥ ekatamaḥ pi ca eṣām

original: śrutvā vacaḥ suruciraṁ tu pṛthag viśeṣaṁ
analyzed: śrutvā vacaḥ su ruciraṁ tu pṛthak viśeṣaṁ
guṇa atiśaya lola tayā sritā asma
na asmākaṁ sugataḥ pitā na ripavaḥ
tu ekānta jagat hitaḥ sa bhagavān
vākyaṁ sarva mala apahāri ca tatas
ye tvāṁ namasyanti muni indra candra
dṛṣṭvā janma jarā vināśa bala tāṁ
jātaḥ śākya kula indraḥ adbhuta matiḥ

original: śāstāraṁ hitam eva kas tam abudho
analyzed: śāstāraṁ hitam eva kaḥ tam abudhaḥ
avaśyam eṣāṁ katamaḥ pi sarva vid
saḥ eva dṛśyaḥ mati sūkṣma cakṣuṣā

original: na santi sarve guṇāś ca vidyante|
analyzed: na santi sarve guṇāḥ ca vidyante
evaṁ stute stuti sahasra nadī samudre
buddhe vibuddha kamala āyata pattra netre

original: yat kiṁ cid asti kuśalaṁ mama vāksamutthaṁ
analyzed: yat kiṁ cit asti kuśalaṁ mama vāc samutthaṁ

original: jātā bhavantu sukhinaḥ khalu tena sarve||21|
analyzed: jātāḥ bhavantu sukhinaḥ khalu tena sarve
